# rms_roles (Data Source)

Retrieves a list of all Teltonika RMS Roles.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "rms_roles" "all" {}

output "role_titles" {
  value = [for r in data.rms_roles.all.roles : r.title]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The identifier for this data source.
- `roles` (Attributes List) List of roles. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--roles))

<a id="nestedatt--roles"></a>
### Nested Schema for `roles`

Read-Only:

- `company_id` (Number) Company ID.
- `description` (String) Role description.
- `id` (Number) Role ID.
- `permission_ids` (Set of Number) List of permission IDs assigned to this role.
- `title` (String) Role title.
